questions.question: What kind of house does SpongeBob SquarePants live in, under the sea?
questions.reveal: SpongeBob's pineapple home sits in the undersea town of Bikini Bottom.

questions.question: In Tom and Jerry, what kind of animal is Jerry?
questions.reveal: Tom and Jerry first appeared in 1940, in a cartoon called Puss Gets the Boot.

questions.question: Which famous question does Bugs Bunny ask while munching a carrot?
questions.reveal: Bugs first said his famous line in the 1940 cartoon A Wild Hare.

questions.question: What is the name of Ash's yellow electric Pokémon best friend?
questions.reveal: Pikachu is number 25 in the National Pokédex.

questions.question: In Peppa Pig, what is the name of Peppa's little brother?
questions.reveal: George loves his toy dinosaur and proudly shouts "Dine-saw! Grrr!"

questions.question: What breed of dog is Scooby-Doo?
questions.reveal: Scooby-Doo, Where Are You! first aired in 1969.

questions.question: What is the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles' favourite food?
questions.reveal: The turtles live in the sewers under New York City.

questions.question: In which town do The Simpsons live?
questions.reveal: The show never says which US state Springfield is in.

questions.question: Which day of the week does Garfield the cat famously hate?
questions.reveal: Garfield also adores lasagne and hates diets.

questions.question: What does Popeye the Sailor eat to become super strong?
questions.reveal: Popeye first appeared in a newspaper comic strip called Thimble Theatre in 1929.

questions.question: Which Australian cartoon follows a Blue Heeler puppy and her little sister, Bingo?
questions.reveal: Bluey is made by Ludo Studio in Brisbane, Queensland.

questions.question: What is the name of the Scooby-Doo gang's colourful van?
questions.reveal: The gang call themselves Mystery Incorporated.

questions.question: What is the name of the Flintstones' Stone Age hometown?
questions.reveal: In 1960, The Flintstones became the first animated series shown in US prime time.

questions.question: Which Looney Tunes cat is forever trying to catch Tweety Bird?
questions.reveal: Tweety's catchphrase is "I tawt I taw a puddy tat!"

questions.question: In Paw Patrol, what is the name of the boy who leads the pups?
questions.reveal: Paw Patrol is set in a seaside town called Adventure Bay.

questions.question: In Dora the Explorer, what is the name of Dora's monkey friend?
questions.reveal: Boots is named after the red boots he loves to wear.

questions.question: What is the name of SpongeBob's pet snail?
questions.reveal: Gary the snail meows just like a cat.

questions.question: Which musical instrument does Lisa Simpson play?
questions.reveal: Lisa is the brainiest Simpson and is also a vegetarian.

questions.question: What colour is Thomas the Tank Engine?
questions.reveal: Thomas has the number 1 painted on his side.

questions.question: Which Ninja Turtle wears a blue mask and fights with two swords?
questions.reveal: All four turtles are named after Italian Renaissance artists.

questions.question: What kind of animal is Splinter, the Ninja Turtles' wise old teacher?
questions.reveal: Splinter teaches the turtles the martial art of ninjutsu.

questions.question: What sound does the Road Runner make as he speeds away?
questions.reveal: Wile E. Coyote buys his gadgets from the Acme Corporation.

questions.question: Which Scooby-Doo character with glasses always cries "Jinkies!"?
questions.reveal: Velma is the brains of the gang and is always losing her glasses.

questions.question: What is the name of The Jetsons' pet dog?
questions.reveal: Astro was voiced by Don Messick, who also voiced Scooby-Doo.

questions.question: In the cartoon Arthur, what kind of animal is Arthur?
questions.reveal: Arthur is based on books by Marc Brown, starting with Arthur's Nose in 1976.

questions.question: What is the name of the Flintstones' purple pet dinosaur?
questions.reveal: Dino barks and behaves just like a pet dog.

questions.question: Who is SpongeBob's grumpy next-door neighbour who plays the clarinet?
questions.reveal: Squidward lives in a house shaped like an Easter Island head.

questions.question: In Phineas and Ferb, what kind of animal is Perry the secret agent?
questions.reveal: When he's on a mission, Perry is known as Agent P.

questions.question: Which Powerpuff Girl has blonde pigtails and wears blue?
questions.reveal: The girls were made from sugar, spice, everything nice and Chemical X.

questions.question: In Rugrats, what is the name of Tommy Pickles' bossy older cousin?
questions.reveal: Angelica's favourite doll is called Cynthia.

questions.question: In Avatar: The Last Airbender, what is the name of Aang's flying bison?
questions.reveal: Appa the sky bison has six legs.

questions.question: In Avatar: The Last Airbender, which element can Katara bend?
questions.reveal: Katara and her brother Sokka are from the Southern Water Tribe.

questions.question: What is the name of the Simpsons' cheerful neighbour who says "Hi-diddly-ho!"?
questions.reveal: Ned runs a shop for left-handed people called the Leftorium.

questions.question: What is the nickname of the spinning Looney Tunes Tasmanian Devil?
questions.reveal: Real Tasmanian devils are the world's largest meat-eating marsupials.

questions.question: Which cartoon bear lives in Jellystone Park and loves pic-a-nic baskets?
questions.reveal: Yogi's little sidekick is a bear cub called Boo-Boo.

questions.question: Which Looney Tunes hunter is always trying to catch Bugs Bunny?
questions.reveal: Elmer famously whispers "Be vewy, vewy quiet, I'm hunting wabbits!"

questions.question: What is the name of Team Rocket's talking cat Pokémon?
questions.reveal: Meowth's partners in Team Rocket are Jessie and James.

questions.question: What is the name of Dexter's annoying ballet-loving big sister in Dexter's Laboratory?
questions.reveal: Dexter keeps his giant laboratory a secret from his parents.

questions.question: What is the name of the evil wizard who's always chasing The Smurfs?
questions.reveal: Gargamel's grumpy pet cat is called Azrael.

questions.question: In Bluey, what is the name of Bluey's dad?
questions.reveal: Bandit works as an archaeologist, and mum Chilli works in airport security.

questions.question: In Hey Arnold!, what shape is Arnold's head said to be?
questions.reveal: Arnold lives with his grandparents in a boarding house called the Sunset Arms.

questions.question: Who is the evil scientist that Perry the Platypus battles in Phineas and Ferb?
questions.reveal: Doofenshmirtz's company is called Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated.

questions.question: Which city do the Powerpuff Girls protect?
questions.reveal: The girls live with their creator, Professor Utonium.

questions.question: What is the name of the Simpsons' pet greyhound?
questions.reveal: Homer and Bart adopted him after he lost a race in the very first full episode.

questions.question: Sandy Cheeks the squirrel comes from which US state?
questions.reveal: Sandy wears an air helmet so she can breathe underwater in Bikini Bottom.

questions.question: Which grass-type Pokémon is number 1 in the National Pokédex?
questions.reveal: Bulbasaur evolves into Ivysaur and then Venusaur.

questions.question: What is the name of The Jetsons' robot maid?
questions.reveal: The Jetsons first aired in 1962 and imagined life in the space age.

questions.question: What is Shaggy's real first name in Scooby-Doo?
questions.reveal: His full name is Norville Rogers, but everyone calls him Shaggy.

questions.question: What toy tool does Tommy Pickles use to escape his playpen in Rugrats?
questions.reveal: Tommy still carries his trusty toy screwdriver in the spin-off All Grown Up!

questions.question: In Adventure Time, what is the name of the magical land where Finn and Jake live?
questions.reveal: Finn's best friend Jake is a magical dog who can stretch into almost any shape.
